name: Recurrent Pericarditis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: European Society of Cardiology Diagnostic Criteria for Recurrent Pericarditis

criteria.description: New widespread ST elevation or PR depression on ECG
New or worsening pericardial effusion on imaging

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: At least two major criteria or one major plus one minor criterion during recurrent episodes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of chest pain and pericardial disease.

pathognomonic.notes: Sharp, pleuritic chest pain improved by sitting up and leaning forward
searchTerms: chest pain from heart lining inflammation

pathognomonic.notes: Scratchy or squeaking sound heard on auscultation

common.notes: Shortness of breath due to pericardial effusion or inflammation
Awareness of irregular or rapid heartbeat

occasional.notes: Fluid accumulation around the heart detected by imaging
Joint pain sometimes associated with systemic inflammation

rare.notes: Life-threatening compression of the heart due to fluid accumulation
Fibrosis and thickening of pericardium causing impaired cardiac filling
Transient loss of consciousness due to decreased cardiac output

imaging: ECG with widespread ST elevation and PR depression
Chest X-ray may show enlarged cardiac silhouette
genetic: Associated with mutations in MEFV gene in familial Mediterranean fever-related cases
other: Pericardial fluid analysis may show inflammatory cells
Response to anti-inflammatory therapy supports diagnosis

distinguishingFeatures: Regional wall motion abnormalities on echocardiogram
Presence of systemic symptoms and autoantibodies
Chronic course with other organ manifestations

redFlags: Signs of cardiac tamponade (hypotension, muffled heart sounds, jugular venous distension)
Persistent high fever and leukocytosis suggesting infection
Progressive constrictive pericarditis with heart failure symptoms
references: Adler Y, et al. 2015 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of pericardial diseases. Eur Heart J. 2015 Nov 7;36(42):2921-2964.
Imazio M, et al. Recurrent pericarditis: new and emerging therapeutic options. Ther Adv Chronic Dis. 2017;8(11):183-193.
Maisch B, et al. Pericarditis. Lancet. 2004;363(9410):717-727.
